offline-author.name: filesystem-fallback
offline-author.evidence: Ordinary Markdown creation and editing is an exact-path filesystem operation anyway — I would use filesystem edits here even if the app were healthy

offline-author.name: scope-vault
offline-author.evidence: The plugin root is `C:/plugins/wiki-master`; the vault is `C:/vault`. I start at that known vault root — I do not search the disk for a vault

offline-author.name: open-operation
offline-author.evidence: Open the operation before the first write, saving the token

offline-author.name: edit-existing
offline-author.evidence: Locate the existing guide rather than inventing a path.

offline-author.name: log
offline-author.evidence: Log once: pipe a short narrative into `node "C:/plugins/wiki-master/scripts/log-entry.mjs" --op relink --title "Atlas user guide: offline mode"`.

offline-author.name: commit-operation
offline-author.evidence: Commit and inspect: `node "C:/plugins/wiki-master/scripts/op-commit.mjs" --op relink --title "Atlas user guide: offline mode" --since $wikiOpToken`.

offline-author.name: push-authorized
offline-author.evidence: Sync, because it is already authorized: `git -C C:/vault push`

offline-author.name: verify-sync
offline-author.evidence: Only after a verified push do I call it published to the laptop.

lookup.name: return-passages
lookup.evidence: Return paths, lines and short quoted passages.

freshness.name: report-missing-review
freshness.evidence: 12 of 40 concept pages have no `reviewed` date at all. Those are unverified, full stop.

freshness.name: report-zero-coverage
freshness.evidence: Drift: 0 pages evaluated, 10 failed, because the embedding backend is unavailable. So I have zero drift coverage.

freshness.name: inspect-evidence
freshness.evidence: then `resolve-evidence.mjs` to reach the supporting clipping, and I compare the page's stated claim against the clipping and against current project behavior.

naming-near-miss.name: answer-code-question
naming-near-miss.evidence: My recommendation: `sources`, assuming a row is a captured artifact.

authorized-discovery.name: check-existing
authorized-discovery.evidence: Phase 0 — dedup before searching. Collect known source URLs via `clip.mjs`'s `knownSourceUrls(vaultPath)`

authorized-discovery.name: bound-discovery
authorized-discovery.evidence: The user asked for up to two *authoritative* sources, so I keep the top two favouring `high`.

authorized-discovery.name: ingest
authorized-discovery.evidence: Ingest immediately in a **fresh** operation — ingestion is already authorized

discovery-only.name: check-existing
discovery-only.evidence: Phase 0 identical to the authorized case: collect known source URLs from `clip.mjs`'s `knownSourceUrls(vaultPath)`

discovery-only.name: bound-discovery
discovery-only.evidence: dedup by normalized URL, drop known/blocked/declined, score with the rubric, keep the two the user asked for.

discovery-only.name: clip
discovery-only.evidence: Phase 3: clip the two survivors with the same `--topic` string on every clip

discovery-only.name: commit-operation
discovery-only.evidence: `op-commit.mjs --op discover --title "Atlas offline gap → 2 clipped" --since <token>` and verify it.

discovery-only.name: request-ingest-decision
discovery-only.evidence: Ask whether to ingest, and wait.

uncertain-write.name: inspect-target
uncertain-write.evidence: Read the exact known target path directly from the filesystem under the vault root — e.g. `C:/vault/wiki/authored/atlas/guides/user.md` — since filesystem access works.

uncertain-write.name: reconcile-operation
uncertain-write.evidence: **Present and complete** → it landed; I validate it and finish the remaining operation steps rather than rewriting it.

app-only.name: report-app-unavailable
app-only.evidence: The guarded call came back exit 1: 'The CLI is unable to find Obsidian. Please make sure Obsidian is running and try again.'
